meaning: [v.] 招收，吸收；登记，注册（入校/加入课程等）
detail: 核心搭配: enroll in (a course / school); enroll sb. in / on sth.; enrollment rate | 考点提示: 单元测试Q15、Q35核心考点，常考搭配 enroll in
example: More college graduates choose to enroll in short-term training courses to improve their practical work skills.
example_trans: 越来越多的大学毕业生选择参加短期培训课程，以提高实际工作技能。

meaning: [n. / v.] n. 目标，目的，宗旨；物体；v. 反对，抗议
detail: 核心搭配: object to doing sth.; a physical object; object of study; raise an objection | 考点提示: 作动词时后接介词 to + 名词/动名词
example: No one objected to the proposal when it was presented at the meeting.
example_trans: 在会议上提出该提案时，没有人表示反对。

meaning: [n. / adj.] n. 目标，目的；adj. 客观的，实事求是的
detail: 核心搭配: achieve one's objective; an objective assessment / view; remain objective | 考点提示: 区分 subjective (主观的)
example: Scientists must maintain an objective attitude when observing natural specimens.
example_trans: 科学家在观察自然标本时必须保持客观的态度。

meaning: [n.] 反对，异议，反对的理由
detail: 核心搭配: have / raise an objection to sth.; without objection | 考点提示: 搭配 have an objection to sth.
example: The committee voiced strong objections to the proposed construction plan.
example_trans: 委员会对拟议的施工方案提出了强烈反对。

meaning: [n. / adj.] n. 前事，先例，祖先，来历；adj. 先行的，先前的
detail: 核心搭配: historical antecedents; antecedent events; antecedent to sth. | 考点提示: 词根 cede (走) + ante (前) -> 先前发生的事物
example: We cannot fully understand the present situation without knowing its historical antecedents.
example_trans: 如果不了解其历史前情，我们就无法充分理解当前的局势。

meaning: [v.] 在...之前发生，先于，走在...前面
detail: 核心搭配: precede sb. / sth.; be preceded by; preceding chapter | 考点提示: 形近词辨析核心：precede (先于), proceed (推进), recede (后退)
example: A brief introduction will precede the guest lecture.
example_trans: 特邀讲座之前会有一段简短的介绍。

meaning: [v.] 继续进行，推进，前进；行进
detail: 核心搭配: proceed with sth.; proceed to do sth.; proceed from | 考点提示: 常用搭配 proceed with 继续进行
example: After a short break, the professor proceeded with his detailed explanation.
example_trans: 短暂休息后，教授继续进行详细的讲解。

meaning: [v.] 后退，退去，渐弱（如潮水退去、记忆减退）
detail: 核心搭配: recede into the distance; recede from view; floodwaters recede | 考点提示: 侧重在空间或时间上向后退缩或逐渐模糊
example: As the years passed, painful childhood memories began to recede into the background.
example_trans: 随着岁月流逝，童年的痛苦记忆开始渐渐淡出脑海。

meaning: [v.] 超过，超出，超越（限度、预算、预期）
detail: 核心搭配: exceed expectations; exceed the speed limit; exceed one's authority | 考点提示: 派生词：exceedingly (adv. 极其，非常)
example: The final sales volume significantly exceeded the company's annual target.
example_trans: 最终的销售额大幅超出了公司的年度目标。

meaning: [v.] 脱离，退出（国家、政党、联盟）
detail: 核心搭配: secede from (a nation / federation); right to secede | 考点提示: 前缀 se- (分开) + cede (走)
example: Several southern states voted to secede from the Union prior to the Civil War.
example_trans: 在内战爆发之前，南部几个州投票决定脱离联邦独立。

meaning: [n.] 标本，样本，抽样
detail: 核心搭配: a biological specimen; collect / examine specimens; specimen bottle | 考点提示: Unit 1课文核心核心实物：解剖台上的鱼标本
example: Professor Agassiz placed a fish specimen in front of the young student for observation.
example_trans: 阿加西斯教授把一条鱼标本放在年轻学生面前让他观察。

meaning: [adj.] 明确的，清楚明白的，直截了当的
detail: 核心搭配: explicit instructions; make sth. explicit; explicit rules; explicitly state | 考点提示: 单元测试Q11核心考点，汉译英重点词；反义词 implicit
example: She did not give explicit answers to every question, but encouraged students to think critically.
example_trans: 她没有对每个问题给出明确直白的答案，而是鼓励学生批判性思考。

meaning: [adj.] 含蓄的，暗示的，内含的；无保留的
detail: 核心搭配: implicit assumption; implicit agreement; implicit trust in sb. | 考点提示: 反义词：explicit
example: There was an implicit understanding between the two researchers that they would share the credit.
example_trans: 两位研究人员之间有一种心照不宣的默契，那就是共享这项学术成果。

meaning: [v.] 委托，托付，把…托付给
detail: 核心搭配: entrust sb. with sth.; entrust sth. to sb. | 考点提示: 单元测试Q22考点，必背双重搭配：entrust sb. with sth. / entrust sth. to sb.
example: The manager decided to entrust the crucial task to a reliable colleague with rich practical experience.
example_trans: 经理决定将这项关键任务托付给一位具有丰富实战经验的可靠同事。

meaning: [v.] 弄湿，使湿润，微湿
detail: 核心搭配: moisten one's lips; moisten with water / alcohol | 考点提示: 后缀 -en 表致使；注意 t 不发音
example: He had to constantly moisten the fish specimen with alcohol to keep it from drying out.
example_trans: 他必须不断用酒精浸润鱼标本，以防其脱水变干。

meaning: [adj.] 微湿的，湿润的，潮湿的
detail: 核心搭配: moist eyes; moist air; keep the surface moist | 考点提示: 微湿偏舒服，区别 damp (阴湿不适)
example: The soil in the greenhouse was kept moist and fertile for seed germination.
example_trans: 温室里的土壤保持湿润肥沃，以促进种子发芽。

meaning: [n.] 水分，湿度，潮气
detail: 核心搭配: moisture content; absorb / retain moisture; moisture cream | 考点提示: 派生词：moisturize (v. 保湿)
example: Plants lose moisture through their leaves during hot summer afternoons.
example_trans: 在炎热夏日的午后，植物会通过叶片散失水分。

meaning: [n.] （瓶子等的）塞子；阻止物，妨碍物
detail: 核心搭配: pull out / replace the stopper; conversation stopper (冷场话) | 考点提示: 课文与题集高频词：conversation stopper 终结谈话的冷场话
example: He pulled the glass stopper from the jar containing the preservative fluid.
example_trans: 他拔掉装有防腐液的广口瓶玻璃塞。

meaning: [v. / n.] v. 投身于，钻研；骤降，暴跌；跳入；n. 暴跌，跳水
detail: 核心搭配: plunge into (work / study / water); take the plunge (毅然决然尝试); plunge dramatically | 考点提示: 单元测试Q26核心考点，重点考查 plunge into 投身于
example: After receiving the assignment, she plunged into her academic research without hesitation.
example_trans: 接到任务后，她毫不犹豫地一头扎进了学术研究中。

meaning: [adj.] 传染性的；（情绪、笑声等）有感染力的
detail: 核心搭配: infectious disease; infectious laughter / enthusiasm; highly infectious | 考点提示: 单元测试Q3核心考点；近义：contagious (接触传染的)
example: His infectious enthusiasm inspired everyone on the project team to work harder.
example_trans: 他极具感染力的热情激励了项目团队中的每一个人更加努力工作。

meaning: [v. / n.] 凝视，注视（长时间、平静、专注或赞叹地看）
detail: 核心搭配: gaze at / into; fix one's gaze upon; steadfast gaze | 考点提示: 四大看辨析之一：gaze(深情/专注凝视) vs stare(吃惊/失礼盯视) vs glance(扫视) vs glimpse(瞥见)
example: The scientist gazed at the tiny details of the fish specimen for hours.

meaning: [v. / n.] 盯，凝视（多因惊讶、震惊或显得粗鲁）
detail: 核心搭配: stare at; stare blankly; stare in disbelief | 考点提示: 常含粗鲁或震惊情绪
example: It is considered impolite to stare at strangers on the street.

meaning: [v. / n.] 匆匆一瞥，扫视，粗略看
detail: 核心搭配: at first glance (乍一看); glance at one's watch; take a glance | 考点提示: 高频短语 at first glance
example: At first glance the problem seemed straightforward, but deeper analysis revealed its complexity.

meaning: [n. / v.] 一瞥，短暂瞥见（常指事物瞬间出现而未看清）
detail: 核心搭配: catch / get a glimpse of; a fleeting glimpse | 考点提示: 搭配 catch a glimpse of 瞥见
example: Fans waited outside for hours just to catch a brief glimpse of the film director.

meaning: [v. / n.] v. （鬼魂）出没；（记忆、恐惧等）萦绕心头；n. 常去之处
detail: 核心搭配: haunt sb.'s memories; be haunted by; a favorite haunt | 考点提示: 题集高频词，多用于抽象记忆萦绕
example: The tragic scene haunted his memory for decades after the event.

meaning: [adj.] 令人难忘的，萦绕心头的，久久不散的（常指旋律、诗句、回忆）
detail: 核心搭配: a haunting melody / tune; haunting beauty; haunting memories | 考点提示: 常修饰 melody, music, beauty
example: The film concluded with a haunting melody that brought tears to the audience's eyes.

meaning: [adj.] 闹鬼的；忧心忡忡的，受困扰的
detail: 核心搭配: a haunted house; have a haunted look on one's face | 考点提示: 形容人面带忧虑或惊恐
example: The soldier returned from the battlefield with a haunted expression in his eyes.

meaning: [v.] 赞扬，表扬；推荐；得到赞同
detail: 核心搭配: commend sb. for sth.; commend itself to sb. (为某人所青睐); highly commended | 考点提示: 单元测试Q12核心考点；搭配 commend sb. for sth.
example: The professor commended the students who had devoted themselves wholeheartedly to scientific inquiry.

meaning: [adj.] 坚定的，不动摇的，始终如一的
detail: 核心搭配: steadfast faith / loyalty; steadfast gaze (凝神专注的目光); remain steadfast | 考点提示: 近义词：firm, resolute, unswerving
example: Despite severe hardships, she remained steadfast in her commitment to medical ethics.

meaning: [adj.] 不情愿的，勉强的 (与 reluctant 同义)
detail: 核心搭配: be loath to do sth. | 考点提示: 注意为形容词，不能带宾语，常作表语 be loath to do sth.
example: He was loath to admit that his initial hypothesis had been completely wrong.

meaning: [v.] 极度厌恶，憎恨 (与 detest, despise 同义)
detail: 核心搭配: loathe doing sth.; loathe sb. / sth. | 考点提示: 注意发音带浊辅音 /ð/，为及物动词
example: They loathe cruelty in any form and advocate for animal welfare.

meaning: [adj.] 令人作呕的，可憎的，极讨厌的
detail: 核心搭配: a loathsome creature; loathsome behavior / smell | 考点提示: 反义：delightful, pleasant
example: The tyrant was remembered throughout history for his loathsome crimes.

meaning: [v.] 禁止，不许（最通用口语与正式词）
detail: 核心搭配: forbid sb. to do sth.; forbid doing sth.; God forbid! | 考点提示: 常考结构 forbid sb. to do / forbid sb. from doing
example: School regulations strictly forbid students from using mobile phones during exams.

meaning: [v.] （通过法律、法规、官方条令）禁止，阻止
detail: 核心搭配: prohibit sb. from doing sth.; strictly prohibited; law prohibits | 考点提示: 侧重官方法律法规约束，搭配 prohibit sb. from doing
example: Municipal laws prohibit smoking in all indoor public spaces and public transport.

meaning: [v. / n.] （官方或社会舆论）明令取缔，全面查禁；禁令
detail: 核心搭配: impose / lift a ban on sth.; ban sb. from doing sth. | 考点提示: 强调社会舆论与官方全面禁止
example: The government decided to impose a total ban on single-use plastics.

meaning: [v. / n.] v. 阻挡，阻止；封锁；n. 酒吧；门闩；障碍
detail: 核心搭配: bar sb. from doing sth.; barred windows; behind bars (在狱中) | 考点提示: 搭配 bar sb. from doing sth.
example: Protesters barred the entrance to the office building, preventing staff from entering.

meaning: [v. / n.] （法律/官方/军事）正式禁止，封锁，阻断
detail: 核心搭配: interdict the drug trade; judicial interdict; interdict supply routes | 考点提示: 极正式书面语及法律/军事术语
example: Naval forces were dispatched to interdict shipments of contraband across the sea.

meaning: [adj.] 显眼的，显著的，引人注目的（易于看见或引起注意）
detail: 核心搭配: conspicuous consumption (炫耀性消费); be conspicuous by one's absence; highly conspicuous | 考点提示: 近义词：noticeable, eye-catching
example: The bright red sign was placed in a conspicuous position near the main gate.

meaning: [adj.] 看得见的，可见的；明显的
detail: 核心搭配: visible to the naked eye; highly visible; visible progress | 考点提示: 单元测试Q7核心考点；反义词 invisible
example: The microscopic organisms are not visible to the naked human eye.

meaning: [adv.] 明显地，显而易见地
detail: 核心搭配: visibly shaken / upset; visibly relieved | 考点提示: 常修饰情感状态形容词
example: She was visibly shaken after hearing the alarming news from home.

meaning: [adj.] 看不见的，无形的
detail: 核心搭配: invisible hand (看不见的手); invisible bacteria; invisible rays | 考点提示: 常用于隐喻或科学语境
example: Ultraviolet rays are completely invisible to the human eye but can damage skin.

meaning: [adv.] 看不见地，暗中，无形地
detail: 核心搭配: operate invisibly; invisibly connected | 考点提示: 副词形式
example: The underlying algorithms work invisibly in the background to filter online content.

meaning: [adj.] 明显的，显而易见的（一目了然毋庸置疑）
detail: 核心搭配: an obvious fact / mistake; for obvious reasons; it is obvious that... | 考点提示: 最通用的'明显'词汇
example: It was obvious from her enthusiastic tone that she loved her academic major.

meaning: [adj.] 显而易见的；表面上的，貌似的
detail: 核心搭配: it became apparent that; apparent contradiction; for no apparent reason | 考点提示: 双重含义：显而易见 vs 表面貌似（apparent vs real）
example: It soon became apparent that the initial calculations contained significant errors.

meaning: [adj.] 突出的，显著的；著名的，杰出的
detail: 核心搭配: play a prominent role; a prominent scholar / feature; prominently displayed | 考点提示: 既指物理上突出，也指社会地位杰出
example: He has played a prominent role in promoting international educational exchanges.

meaning: [adj.] 引人注目的，异乎寻常的，深刻醒目的
detail: 核心搭配: a striking resemblance (惊人相似); a striking difference; striking features | 考点提示: 经典搭配：striking resemblance / contrast
example: There is a striking resemblance between the two historical events.

meaning: [adj.] 极不幸的，悲惨的，难受的；恶劣的，糟糕的
detail: 核心搭配: feel wretched; live in wretched poverty; wretched conditions | 考点提示: 单元测试Q8考点，汉译英重点词汇
example: Occasionally we would feel wretched because we had to spend hours reading the difficult text.

meaning: [adv.] 悲惨地，可怜地，极其
detail: 核心搭配: wretchedly poor; feel wretchedly ill | 考点提示: 副词形式
example: They lived wretchedly in makeshift tents during the harsh winter months.

meaning: [v.] 向…保证，使确信（侧重打消某人顾虑）
detail: 核心搭配: assure sb. of sth.; assure sb. that...; rest assured (请放心) | 考点提示: 宾语必须接人：assure sb. that / assure sb. of sth.
example: The doctor assured the anxious parents that the surgery had been completely successful.

meaning: [v.] 确保，保证（确保事情实现或发生）
detail: 核心搭配: ensure that...; ensure success / safety; take steps to ensure | 考点提示: 宾语接事物或从句：ensure that / ensure sth.（不接人）
example: We must take immediate measures to ensure that academic regulations are strictly followed.

meaning: [v.] 使安心，使消除疑虑（使恢复信心和平静）
detail: 核心搭配: reassure sb. about sth.; reassure sb. that...; smile reassuringly | 考点提示: 单元测试Q20核心考点，重点指'使消退忧虑'
example: The tutor tried to reassure the nervous freshman that everyone makes mistakes at the start.

meaning: [adj.] 令人安心的，宽慰的
detail: 核心搭配: a reassuring smile / voice / message; reassuring news | 考点提示: 修饰事物或举止
example: Hearing her mother's calm voice on the telephone was extremely reassuring.

meaning: [adj.] 对称的，匀称的
detail: 核心搭配: symmetrical organs; bilateral symmetry; perfectly symmetrical | 考点提示: 课文核心生物学考点：课文中提及的'对称器官'
example: Professor Agassiz pointed out that the fish possessed symmetrical organs on both sides.

meaning: [n. / v.] n. 目录，全套清单；v. 编入目录，系统列出
detail: 核心搭配: library catalogue; mail-order catalogue; catalogue all known species | 考点提示: 也可拼写为 catalog
example: Biologists spent several decades cataloguing all local marine species.

meaning: [adj.] 无法估量的，极其宝贵的（价值巨大到无法计算）
detail: 核心搭配: inestimable value / worth; of inestimable benefit to | 考点提示: 四大价值词辨析之一：inestimable (无法估量的) vs invaluable (极其宝贵的) vs priceless (无价的) vs worthless (毫无价值的)
example: The ancient manuscripts are of inestimable historical and cultural value.

meaning: [adj.] 极宝贵的，极其有用的（切勿误判为'不值钱'）
detail: 核心搭配: invaluable advice / assistance; prove invaluable to | 考点提示: 易错警示：invaluable 意为'极宝贵的'，而不是 worthless
example: Her practical experience in fieldwork proved invaluable during the archaeological project.

meaning: [adj.] 无价的，极其珍贵的；滑稽可笑的
detail: 核心搭配: priceless art treasures; priceless moments / advice | 考点提示: 近义词：invaluable, beyond price
example: The museum houses a priceless collection of Renaissance oil paintings.

meaning: [adj.] 无价值的，毫无用处的，一文不值的
detail: 核心搭配: worthless paper / promise; totally worthless | 考点提示: 反义词：priceless, invaluable
example: Without accurate data, all these theoretical models are completely worthless.

meaning: [n.] 遗产，遗赠；历史留给后世的产物/精神财富
detail: 核心搭配: cultural / historical legacy; leave a lasting legacy; legacy of colonialism | 考点提示: 课文课后核心主题词
example: Agassiz's scientific legacy continues to inspire generations of modern zoologists.

meaning: [v.] 像，与…相似（不用于被动语态或进行时）
detail: 核心搭配: closely / strongly resemble sb.; resemble each other | 考点提示: 语法警示：resemble 不用于被动语态，也不与 with 连用
example: The newborn dolphin closely resembled its mother in color and form.

meaning: [n.] 相似，形似，相似之处
detail: 核心搭配: bear a strong resemblance to; striking resemblance; little resemblance | 考点提示: 核心搭配：bear a resemblance to 与…有相似之处
example: There is a striking resemblance between the architecture of the two ancient cities.

meaning: [v.] 不同，相异，有区别；产生分歧
detail: 核心搭配: differ from sb./sth.; differ in (size / opinion); beg to differ | 考点提示: 搭配 differ from (区别于) / differ in (在…方面不同)
example: The two subspecies differ significantly in the structure of their tail fins.

meaning: [n.] 区别，差别；优秀，杰出；特点
detail: 核心搭配: make / draw a distinction between; a person of distinction; with distinction | 考点提示: 搭配 draw a distinction between
example: Philosophers often draw a clear distinction between moral facts and subjective opinions.

meaning: [n.] 解剖，生物解剖；仔细剖析
detail: 核心搭配: dissection table (解剖台); perform a dissection; rigorous dissection of the text | 考点提示: 课文高频场景词：解剖与显微镜观察
example: The biology laboratory had several fish specimens lined up on the dissection table.

meaning: [v.] 解剖；仔细剖析，仔细审查
detail: 核心搭配: dissect an animal / frog; dissect a poem / argument | 考点提示: 引申为文学或逻辑上的深度剖析
example: Students were asked to dissect the poem line by line to understand its metaphorical structure.

meaning: [n.] 厌恶，反感，极度讨厌
detail: 核心搭配: have / hold an aversion to; a deep-rooted aversion; risk aversion | 考点提示: 单元测试Q23、Q32核心考点，必背搭配 hold an aversion to
example: Many people hold a strong aversion to online gossip because it often spreads false rumors.

meaning: [n. / v.] n. 企图，努力；投标，出价；v. 出价；命令，致意
detail: 核心搭配: submit a bid for; make a bid for power; in a bid to do sth.; bid farewell to | 考点提示: 单元测试Q13核心考点，必背搭配 submit a bid for
example: Several construction companies submitted a bid for the municipal renewal project.

meaning: [n.] 不情愿，勉强
detail: 核心搭配: show reluctance to do sth.; overcome one's reluctance; with reluctance | 考点提示: 单元测试Q14核心考点
example: He accepted the promotion with obvious reluctance, knowing the heavy stress involved.

meaning: [adj.] 不情愿的，勉强的
detail: 核心搭配: be reluctant to do sth.; reluctant consent | 考点提示: 搭配 be reluctant to do sth.
example: Many employees were reluctant to adopt the new digital tracking system.

meaning: [n. / v.] n. 特征，特色；容貌；v. 以…为特色，重点介绍
